subtests.name: Canvas descendants are hittable after OffscreenCanvas.updateElementGeometry.
Canvas descendants are hit in reverse update order.
Re-updating an element moves it to the top of the hit testing list.
preserveHitTestOrder: true preserves existing hit testing order.
preserveHitTestOrder: false moves element to top of the hit testing list.
preserveHitTestOrder: true preserves order when another element is on top.
preserveHitTestOrder: true adds element to hit testing stack if not already present.
preserveHitTestOrder works when updating via ElementImage on OffscreenCanvas.
